propositions: Type-tier comparability rule allows blocking links only between same-tier tickets (epic-epic, story-story, task/bug-task/bug), causing cross-tier siblings under the same parent to escalate incorrectly and record on the parent instead of directly.
Redundancy guard evaluates the original pair before promotion, missing cases where a promoted pair is ancestor-descendant and should be rejected.

Structural comparability via nearest-common-ancestor resolves blocking endpoints to the lowest common parent's direct children, treating all parentless tickets as siblings via a virtual-root sentinel.
Redundancy guard must re-evaluate the promoted pair, rejecting any blocking edge whose resolved endpoints are in an ancestor-descendant relationship.
Deep hierarchy chains exceeding the current max_hops=2 cap on _get_ancestors truncate to chain root, preventing correct NCA resolution; walking to actual root with cycle-guard solves this.
Self-loops and cross-subtree dependencies between cousins in different sub-trees now escalate to their direct parents rather than recording directly or escalating to chain root.
